checks.name: Semantic HTML structure
checks.desc: Google reads your site like a book — it needs proper chapters and headings, not a wall of text

checks.name: Single H1 per page
checks.desc: One clear headline per page tells Google exactly what it's about — multiple H1s confuse it

checks.name: Unique page titles
checks.desc: Each page has its own title in the browser tab and Google results — not all the same

checks.name: Meta descriptions
checks.desc: The two lines under your link in Google — written to make people actually click

checks.name: Canonical URLs
checks.desc: Tells Google which version of a page is the real one — prevents your own pages competing against each other

checks.name: Open Graph tags
checks.desc: Controls how your site looks when shared on WhatsApp or Facebook — title, image, description

checks.name: Favicon & app icon
checks.desc: The small icon in the browser tab and on phone home screens — looks amateur without it

checks.name: Character encoding
checks.desc: Prevents text from showing as garbled symbols — especially with phone numbers and special characters

checks.name: Viewport meta tag
checks.desc: The line of code that tells phones to show your site at the right size — without it, everything is tiny

checks.name: Language declaration
checks.desc: Tells browsers and Google the site is in English — affects translation prompts and regional ranking

checks.name: robots.txt file
checks.desc: Tells Google which pages to index and which to ignore — a misconfigured one can hide your whole site

checks.name: XML sitemap
checks.desc: A map of every page submitted to Google — helps new sites get found faster

checks.name: LocalBusiness schema
checks.desc: Hidden code that tells Google your exact name, address, phone, and hours in a format it understands perfectly

checks.name: Service schema markup
checks.desc: Labels your services so Google can show them directly in search results — before someone clicks

checks.name: Clean URL structure
checks.desc: /web-design/corby instead of /?p=42 — readable URLs rank better and look more trustworthy

checks.name: Internal linking
checks.desc: Pages linking to each other logically — helps Google understand which pages matter most

checks.name: No broken links
checks.desc: Dead links lose you ranking points and look unprofessional — we check every single one

checks.name: HTTPS redirect
checks.desc: Anyone typing your address without https gets automatically sent to the secure version — no gaps

checks.name: NAP consistency
checks.desc: Your Name, Address, Phone must be identical everywhere online — even one mismatch can hurt local rankings

label: 03 — Speed
title: Speed & Performance
subtitle: Google measures three speed scores (Core Web Vitals) and uses them to rank you. A slow site ranks lower — no exceptions.

checks.name: WebP image format
checks.desc: Modern image format that's 30–50% smaller than JPEG with the same quality — pages load faster

checks.name: Image dimensions set
checks.desc: Without this, the page jumps as images load — Google penalises this and users hate it

checks.name: Lazy loading images
checks.desc: Images below the screen don't load until you scroll to them — makes the page feel instant

checks.name: Hero image priority
checks.desc: The first big image loads before everything else — so the page looks full within 1 second

checks.name: Minified CSS & JS
checks.desc: All code is compressed — like zipping a file before sending — so it arrives faster

checks.name: Font loading strategy
checks.desc: Fonts show placeholder text while loading instead of blank space — no invisible text on slow connections

checks.name: Gzip compression
checks.desc: The server sends compressed files — like a courier packing tighter boxes — cuts transfer size by 70%

checks.name: LCP under 2.5s
checks.desc: Largest Contentful Paint — how long until the main content appears. Google wants under 2.5 seconds

checks.name: CLS under 0.1
checks.desc: Cumulative Layout Shift — measures page jumping. If a button moves as you tap it, that's CLS

checks.name: CDN for static files
checks.desc: Files served from a server closest to the visitor — someone in Glasgow loads as fast as someone in London

label: 04 — Accessibility
title: Accessibility
subtitle: Screen readers, keyboard users, people with poor vision — and Google crawls your site exactly like a screen reader.

checks.name: Alt text on all images
checks.desc: A description of every image — read aloud for visually impaired users, and indexed by Google for image search

checks.name: Form labels
checks.desc: Every input field is properly labelled — screen readers announce what to type, not just silence

checks.name: Colour contrast ratio
checks.desc: Text must be dark enough against background — light grey on white fails and is unreadable in sunlight

checks.name: Keyboard navigation
checks.desc: The full site works using only Tab and Enter — required by law for public-facing UK websites

checks.name: Visible focus states
checks.desc: When you tab through a page, the active element is highlighted — many sites break this accidentally

checks.name: Icon button labels
checks.desc: A phone icon with no text still needs a hidden label — otherwise screen readers say nothing

checks.name: Touch target sizes
checks.desc: Buttons and links are at least 44x44px — so fingers on phones don't tap the wrong thing

checks.name: Pinch-to-zoom enabled
checks.desc: Some sites disable zooming — that's bad for accessibility and penalised by Google on mobile

checks.name: Skip navigation link
checks.desc: Keyboard users can jump straight to the content — skipping the menu every single time

checks.name: SSL certificate
checks.desc: The padlock in the browser bar — without it Chrome shows Not Secure and most visitors leave immediately

checks.name: Security headers
checks.desc: Invisible rules that stop hackers injecting malicious code into your pages — most cheap sites skip these

checks.name: Clickjacking protection
checks.desc: Prevents your site being secretly embedded inside another page to trick your visitors

checks.name: Spam protection on forms
checks.desc: Honeypot fields and rate limiting — stops bots flooding your inbox with fake enquiries

checks.name: Cookie consent banner
checks.desc: UK ICO law requires consent before setting tracking cookies — ignoring this can result in fines

checks.name: Privacy Policy page
checks.desc: Legally required if you collect any data — even just a contact form email address counts

checks.name: GDPR-compliant forms
checks.desc: No pre-ticked boxes, clear consent language — UK GDPR is still enforced post-Brexit

checks.name: Company details in footer
checks.desc: If you're a Ltd company, Companies House number and registered address must appear on your website

checks.name: Click-to-call phone link
checks.desc: Your phone number is a real tap-to-call link — not just text that people have to manually type
